mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, p.note, p.file_id, f.path AS image_url, p.created_at FROM templates p LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = p.file_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO templates(id, name, status, note, file_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{name}, #{status}, #{note}, #{fileId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
